title: EDENS ZERO
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shiki Granbell, a boy with gravity powers raised by robots on an abandoned amusement-park planet, befriends video creator Rebecca and her cat Happy and leaves home to see the cosmos. Given the warship Edens Zero, he gathers a crew to search for the space goddess Mother. Over 33 volumes the adventure turns darker, as his robot grandfather Ziggy is revived as a machine-supremacist Demon King and the crew must save a dying universe.
life_message: Friends are family, and every being, human or machine, deserves to be befriended.

content.note: Constant battles; Shiki is killed and revived; antimatter bombs and extinction war (Wikipedia; AniList Swordplay, Guns, Super Power).
A critic called it Mashima's darkest work; robots die out, sacrifices (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy, Slavery).
Fan service: AniList Ecchi, Large Breasts, Bondage, Tentacles; MangaDex suggestive. Capped (to verify); likely understated.
Loss and loneliness of the last robots; grief.
Chasing views as a content creator; fighting.

folkways.japan: Nakama (crew) loyalty and Shiki's respect for his robot elders reflect shonen manga norms and Japanese affection for robots as companions.

delivery.evidence: No review comment on delivery found; summaries show friendship with robots set against a machine-supremacist villain (to verify).

delivery.note: Summaries show the crew's view of friendship carried by the adventure, against a villain who was once Shiki's grandfather.

winners_losers: Shiki's crew and the universe survive; machine supremacism and Drakken Joe lose. Sympathy goes to friendship that includes robots.
